entries.title: Unsupported DDV save version
entries.message: This save is outside the currently verified DDV v1.25.0 / schema 624 World Editor contract.
entries.action: Use a supported save or wait for the matching Core compatibility contract.

entries.title: Destination platform contract unavailable
entries.message: The selected destination platform is not covered by the current full-design destination contract.
entries.action: Use a currently supported destination platform.

entries.title: Grid route unresolved
entries.message: Wand cannot resolve an exact portable GridDataPath route for this operation.
entries.action: Choose a route with authoritative GridDataPath identity.

entries.title: Grid bounds unavailable
entries.message: Authoritative GridData dimensions are unavailable for this root.
entries.action: Keep the draft read-only for bounds-dependent operations.

entries.title: Grid bounds unavailable
entries.message: Authoritative GridDataPath dimensions are not bound for this destination root.
entries.action: Do not apply placement until the destination bounds contract is available.

entries.title: Outside Grid bounds
entries.message: The draft extends beyond authoritative GridData bounds.
entries.action: Move the selection back inside the valid Grid extent.

entries.title: Exact DDV build unverified
entries.message: The save identifies the supported schema, but it does not prove the exact DDV executable Build ID. The local draft may continue, but native placement is not promoted to verified.
entries.action: Treat this as a draft-only result; persistent Apply remains unavailable.

entries.title: Native placement rejected
entries.message: The promoted DDV native placement classifier rejects this draft position.
entries.action: Move or rotate the affected object and run validation again.

entries.title: Native placement unverified
entries.message: Native placement could not be verified for this object, geometry, occupancy, or conflict state.
entries.action: Do not treat UNKNOWN as VALID. Adjust the draft or wait for the missing Core evidence.

entries.title: Replacement/removal policy unresolved
entries.message: DDV placement may require replacing or removing an existing object, but Wand does not yet have complete safe CanBeCleared/replacement policy coverage.
entries.action: Keep the operation draft-only and avoid persistent mutation.

entries.title: Replacement/removal policy unresolved
entries.message: Destination placement is native-valid only through replacement/removal behavior whose persistent policy is not closed.
entries.action: Do not Apply until Core closes the replacement/removal policy contract.

entries.title: Destination placement invalid
entries.message: At least one destination object placement is rejected by native placement legality.
entries.action: Review the affected object and destination placement.

entries.title: Destination placement unverified
entries.message: At least one destination object remains NATIVE_UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED.
entries.action: Do not promote the destination to Apply-ready.

entries.title: Object geometry unresolved
entries.message: The object footprint or geometry required for safe placement validation is unresolved.
entries.action: Keep this object read-only for geometry-dependent draft operations.

entries.title: Rotation geometry unavailable
entries.message: The current Core geometry adapter is not bound for this rotation.
entries.action: Leave the object unchanged.

entries.title: Multi-selection rotation unavailable
entries.message: The current Core contract cannot resolve the requested multi-selection rotation.
entries.action: Leave the selection unchanged.

entries.title: Custom pivot unsupported
entries.message: The current Core rotation contract does not support a custom selection pivot.
entries.action: Use the supported selection rotation behavior.

entries.title: Draft operation unsupported
entries.message: This command is outside the current v1.25 World Editor authoring contract.
entries.action: Use one of the currently supported draft commands.

entries.title: Legacy Building blocker
entries.message: The blanket Building blocker has been superseded by promoted v1.10 typed category gates.
entries.action: Rebuild the artifact with the current Building v1.10 binding.

entries.title: Building v1.10 contract unavailable
entries.message: The promoted Building read/model/preflight contract is not bound to this WEP flow.
entries.action: Keep Building capture and destination reuse blocked until the exact v1.10 contract is loaded.

entries.title: Building semantics unknown
entries.message: Wand cannot prove that this Building is ordinary. House/Other requires every promoted special/global/shared signal to resolve authoritatively false.
entries.action: Do not infer ordinary placement. Supply the missing authoritative Building classification evidence.

entries.title: Special Building transform blocked
entries.message: This Building has special/global/shared lifecycle semantics and cannot use ordinary same-grid transform behavior.
entries.action: Keep the transform blocked until a dedicated lifecycle contract is promoted.

entries.title: Special Building placement blocked
entries.message: This Building class requires dedicated placement/lifecycle behavior rather than ordinary Grid placement.
entries.action: Do not route it through the ordinary Building placement path.

entries.title: Character House lifecycle required
entries.message: Character House presence and removal can affect character state, so generic Building placement is unsafe.
entries.action: Keep Character House placement/transfer/removal blocked.

entries.title: Stall / Shop lifecycle unresolved
entries.message: StallData and global shop state have linked lifecycle semantics that are not closed for copy/apply.
entries.action: Keep Stall / Shop placement and reuse blocked.

entries.title: Well / Fast Travel lifecycle required
entries.message: Well placement is linked to global fast-travel identity and state.
entries.action: Keep Well / Fast Travel mutation blocked.

entries.title: Garden lifecycle required
entries.message: Garden typed state requires a dedicated lifecycle contract.
entries.action: Keep Garden mutation blocked.

entries.title: Off-grid Building lifecycle required
entries.message: This Building is owned by an off-grid/ProfileWorld lifecycle rather than ordinary Grid placement.
entries.action: Keep off-grid Building mutation blocked.

entries.title: Shared Building synchronizer lifecycle required
entries.message: This Building participates in shared/global synchronization and cannot be treated as an ordinary Grid object.
entries.action: Keep mutation blocked until the synchronizer lifecycle is closed.

entries.title: Special Building semantics unresolved
entries.message: Wand has evidence that ordinary placement cannot be assumed, but the exact special lifecycle is unresolved.
entries.action: Keep the Building fail-closed.

entries.title: Building geometry unresolved
entries.message: The Building class is ordinary-capable, but its source footprint is not authoritative enough for portable placement.
entries.action: Keep placement capture blocked until geometry is resolved.

entries.title: Building stock / ownership check unavailable
entries.message: Ordinary Building destination placement requires a destination stock/ownership check.
entries.action: Keep destination placement blocked until this validator is bound.

entries.title: Building multiplicity check unavailable
entries.message: Ordinary Building destination placement requires a current-scene already-placed/multiplicity check.
entries.action: Keep destination placement blocked until this validator is bound.

entries.title: Building initial-state check unavailable
entries.message: Ordinary Building destination placement requires typed initial-state/provider compatibility validation.
entries.action: Keep destination placement blocked until this validator is bound.

entries.title: Building stock / ownership rejected
entries.message: The destination stock/ownership validator rejected this Building placement.
entries.action: Do not place the Building at this destination.

entries.title: Building multiplicity rejected
entries.message: The destination already-placed/multiplicity validator rejected this Building placement.
entries.action: Resolve the destination multiplicity conflict.

entries.title: Building typed state incompatible
entries.message: The destination typed initial-state/provider validator rejected this Building placement.
entries.action: Do not place the Building with incompatible typed state.

entries.title: Building destination route unresolved
entries.message: An ordinary Building artifact could not be rebound to a destination-local direct Grid.
entries.action: Keep this Building destination preflight blocked.

entries.title: Building destination bounds unavailable
entries.message: Authoritative destination GridData bounds or tessellation do not validate this Building placement.
entries.action: Keep this Building destination preflight blocked.

entries.title: Building placement classifier unavailable
entries.message: The promoted v1.8/v1.9 FloorType/native placement binding is unavailable for this ordinary Building.
entries.action: Keep Building placement blocked.

entries.title: Building placement preflight error
entries.message: Native placement preflight could not be completed for this ordinary Building.
entries.action: Keep the Building blocked and review the detailed preflight error.

entries.title: Building classification mismatch
entries.message: The destination preflight classification does not match the source artifact classification evidence.
entries.action: Do not reinterpret the Building class; rebuild or review the artifact.

entries.title: Building v1.10 preflight blocked
entries.message: At least one Building did not satisfy its promoted typed category gate.
entries.action: Review the class-specific blocker before reuse.

entries.title: Building cross-Grid transfer blocked
entries.message: Building cross-Grid transfer requires lifecycle semantics beyond same-Grid ordinary transforms.
entries.action: Keep cross-Grid Building transfer blocked.

entries.title: Building removal writer unavailable
entries.message: Building removal may update inventory or category-specific state and is not authorized for persistent mutation.
entries.action: Do not persistently remove this Building.

entries.title: Building base replacement blocked
entries.message: Generic different-ItemID Building replacement semantics are not promoted.
entries.action: Do not replace the base Building definition.

entries.title: Road/Fence topology crosses the capture boundary
entries.message: The selected Capture Region would cut through a native Road/Fence component.
entries.action: Expand the Capture Region so the entire connected component is contained.

entries.title: Road/Fence model unavailable
entries.message: The current root cannot be represented through the promoted Road/Fence logical reader.
entries.action: Keep Road/Fence authoring read-only for this root.

entries.title: Road/Fence lattice unresolved
entries.message: Wand cannot prove the native logical-to-save coordinate lattice for this Road/Fence family in the current root.
entries.action: Start from an existing network of the same family or keep new topology creation blocked.

entries.title: Portable Fence post layout unresolved
entries.message: Wand could not bind exactly one Core-valid representation layout to the captured artifact-local Fence topology.
entries.action: Keep the capture fail-closed; restore a valid representation model or undo the topology change.

entries.title: Semantic Fence anchor cannot move
entries.message: Endpoint, corner, junction, and mode-boundary anchors are topology semantics, not representation-only posts.
entries.action: Use a topology operation instead of a post-layout operation.

entries.title: Fence post interval too large
entries.message: The requested post spacing exceeds the family/mode interval supported by the versioned Core catalog.
entries.action: Insert or move a post to produce a supported interval.

entries.title: Fence post interval unsupported
entries.message: The requested interval is not present in the exact Core extension vocabulary for this Fence family and mode.
entries.action: Choose spacing that the current family/mode catalog can represent.

entries.title: Fence post is off its semantic run
entries.message: Representation-only posts must remain on the same straight semantic run.
entries.action: Move the post within its current run or use a topology edit.

entries.title: Fence topology changed
entries.message: The previous representation layout no longer matches the logical Fence topology.
entries.action: Regenerate and preflight representation layout.

entries.title: Fence logical quantity changed
entries.message: A representation-only operation cannot change logical Fence quantity.
entries.action: Use a topology operation and then regenerate representation layout.

entries.title: Placed-object composition unresolved
entries.message: One or more direct-root objects are not portable under the current Core contract.
entries.action: Review the unresolved root objects before publication or reuse.

entries.title: Direct-root document missing
entries.message: One or more direct-root EditorDocuments could not be bound into the full-design artifact.
entries.action: Load all authoritative direct roots before treating the design as complete.

entries.title: Road/Fence capture bounds unavailable
entries.message: The logical reader is available, but authoritative full-root bounds are missing.
entries.action: Keep full-root Road/Fence capture blocked.

entries.title: Road/Fence destination capture missing
entries.message: The full-design artifact does not contain the required portable Road/Fence network capture for destination preflight.
entries.action: Rebuild the source artifact from all required direct roots.

entries.title: Road/Fence destination route unresolved
entries.message: A portable Road/Fence capture could not be rebound to its destination-local direct Grid.
entries.action: Keep destination reuse blocked for this root.

entries.title: Road/Fence destination bounds unavailable
entries.message: Authoritative GridData bounds evidence is unavailable for the destination Road/Fence root.
entries.action: Keep Road/Fence destination reuse blocked until authoritative bounds are available.

entries.title: Road/Fence destination Grid mismatch
entries.message: The resolved destination Grid tessellation does not match the authoritative portable root contract.
entries.action: Do not reinterpret or rescale the Road/Fence artifact; keep the destination blocked.

entries.title: Building recognition incomplete
entries.message: One or more Building-related source states are not safely recognized.
entries.action: Keep the Building category provisional and blocked.

entries.title: Building restoration state unresolved
entries.message: A Building Skin or PlayerHouse restoration state could not be captured safely.
entries.action: Do not publish or reuse the full design as complete.

entries.title: Required design category excluded
entries.message: A required full-design category was excluded, so the artifact is not complete.
entries.action: Include every required category or keep the design incomplete.

entries.title: Full-design publication adapter unavailable
entries.message: The source artifact candidate is complete, but Community publication for this full-design type is not yet connected.
entries.action: Keep publicationReady=false until the Community adapter is bound.

entries.title: DDV Apply unavailable
entries.message: The WEP preflight path is available, but no authorized Core persistent commit adapter is bound.
entries.action: Review the preflight only; do not write the DDV save.

entries.title: Persistent writer unavailable
entries.message: No authorized persistent DDV save writer is bound to this World Editor session.
entries.action: Export/review the draft only; do not replace the source save.

entries.title: Atomic persistent commit unavailable
entries.message: The current Core contract does not authorize atomic persistent world commit.
entries.action: Stop after preview and preflight.
